document.title: Chrome Auto Dealership Operating System
document.subtitle: A three-month foundation, with a phased path to the complete vision
document.author: NeuralSync Canada — Sohaib Sajid
document.source_note: Source: Chrome Auto Next Decade Proposals, 28 October 2026, condensed for review.

pages.text: One place to see what came in, who owns it, what happened next, what each vehicle costs, whether a deal is funded, and where management must intervene.
The three-month foundation starts with the daily dealership workflows. Vehicle costs and funding controls follow only in separately approved phases. Current revenue-producing systems stay live.

items: Pay nothing before the phone proof.
Paid build begins only after you approve the phone plan.
Current systems stay live until you approve a transition in writing.
Monthly service starts only after Phase 1 acceptance.

rows: Connect approved lead and inventory sources; build the first dashboard.
Trace a lead, vehicle and call to the assigned owner.
Run core workflows with selected staff on desktop and phone browser.
Review live or approved test activity in the weekly session.
Stabilize, train, document and complete acceptance.
Check priority issues are closed or accepted with a written plan.

items: Owner and manager dashboard on desktop and phone browser.
Leads with original source and vehicle context preserved.
CarsForSale inventory, subject to approved access and data quality.
Calls, messages, appointments and follow-up in one place.
Manager visibility into missed follow-up, ownership and exceptions.
Approved contact frequency, opt-out and stop rules.

pages.label: NOT IN PHASE 1
pages.text: Native app; vehicle cost accounting; mechanic approvals; finance or lender records; second rooftop; buying agent; full 360 rollout; social automation; or unlimited development.
Each later phase is scoped and approved separately, only after reviewing prior results. No later phase is authorized by Phase 1.

rows: Vehicle costs, mechanic updates, approvals and profit per unit.
Cash or financed, lender, funded status and restricted finance access.
Media pilot on a few vehicles, next-rooftop pilot and native-app decision.
Buying agent, full 360 rollout and social automation.

items: A 30-minute weekly review of working evidence, blockers and next actions.
One shared issue log with an owner, priority and closure evidence.
Chrome Auto retains its data, with agreed exports and transition documentation.
Sensitive finance and identity data is not stored as ordinary message text.

pages.text: 07  PRICE — WHAT YOU PAY AND WHAT YOU GET

rows: Phone proof: call route, human transfer, fallback plan and written recommendation.
Month 1: first dashboard, connected lead and inventory sources, and a lead / vehicle / call you can trace.
Month 2: core workflows live with selected staff, on desktop and phone browser.
Month 3: stabilized system, training, documentation and transition decision.
Monitoring, support, maintenance and operating review. Provider usage: $200–$300/month planning range, billed at actual cost and shown monthly. New modules and integrations are separate.

pages.label: COMMERCIAL BOUNDARY
pages.text: No later module is included in the Phase 1 total. Signing Phase 1 does not approve later work. Currency, retainer scope and applicable taxes require confirmation in the final agreement.

items: Confirm scope, phone proof and named reviewers.
NeuralSync demonstrates the proposed phone route and fallback.
Chrome Auto approves the phone plan or declines. If declined, the paid build does not begin.
If approved, start Month 1 under the terms in the price table.
